newsitem.title: USA: Alliance to redeem 7-1/2 pct debentures.
newsitem.headline: Alliance to redeem 7-1/2 pct debentures.

text.p: Alliance Gaming Corp on Wednesday said it set July 29 as the redemption date for all its outstanding 7 1/2 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2003.
The holders of the debentures will receive the redemption price of 104.69 percent of the principal amount of the outstanding debentures together with accrued and unpaid interest through July 29.

The company, which operates gambling devices and off-track betting parlors, said in a statement that interest on the notes will cease to accrue July 29. About $1.6 million of the debentures are outstanding.
The current conversion price of the debentures is $10.
